meta.method: osmium extract of the zone envelope, tags-filter for moorings, marinas, slipways, piers, docks, lock gates and locks, ferry terminals, houseboats, historic ships and wrecks, movable bridges and seamarks; one item per element at its centroid with a short list of tags. Unnamed seamarks are counted, not listed. Houseboat names are the names mappers gave the boats; no occupant data is held or sought.
